To me, whenever I glimpse those rare moments where everything doesn't feel like it's weight... it's crazy to me how our Health changes the way we experience life (Phenomenology).

However, we are not merely deterministic creatures driven by the Physical; our Psyche plays as equal a role, if not, a greater role, than that of our very body. Therefore, the only natural proceeding inference, is that the Human being is more than the body... perhaps, we are built for Potentiality itself. 

That is as far as this work is willing to explore
